_comment: The second post on the stronghold route, at the cable run halfway up. Three creatures, all tethered, all a couple of levels above the picket's. This is where the player finds out that a trainer battle is an ATTRITION problem: three fights back to back with no healing in between, against someone whose team resets if you break off.
title: Team Tether
_comment_model: The dwarf, 1.53m against the picket's 1.80m and the Warden's 1.96m. Three Tether trainers, three heights, in ascending order up the road — so the route has a rising silhouette without a single line of dialogue explaining rank.
_comment_lines: PLACEHOLDER TEXT. §3's true believer: the one who thinks the tether is a kindness.
challenge: They're better off on the line. Steadier. You'll see when you've lost.
defeat: You think you freed something. You made it somebody else's problem.
